groups.name: Women of Faith
groups.description: Sisters encouraging sisters. A place for women to share life, pray for one another, and grow together in the Word.

groups.name: Men of Faith
groups.description: Brothers sharpening brothers. A place for men to talk honestly about faith, family, work, and walking with God — iron sharpens iron.

groups.name: Testimonies & Encouragement
groups.description: Share what God has done. Your story of His faithfulness might be the exact words someone else needs today — and when you need lifting, this is where the family shows up.

groups.name: New to the Faith
groups.description: A gentle front door. New believer? Coming back after a long time away? Start here — first steps, honest questions, and a family that remembers what day one felt like. No question is off limits.

groups.name: Worship & New Music
groups.description: New releases, worship moments, and artist discoveries from the Sanctuary. Share the songs that are carrying you right now and find your next favorite artist in the family.

groups.name: Bible Study & Discussion
groups.description: Walking through Scripture together, one passage at a time. Bring your questions, your notes, and what the Word is showing you — this is where the 16:3 family studies the Bible side by side.

groups.name: Prayer Warriors
groups.description: The intercession home of 16:3 Faith. Post your prayer requests here, commit to praying for others, and come back and share what God has done. No request is too small and no situation is too far gone — we pray first.
